items.summary: Overall disposition: blocked. Keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only; do not launch public beta, full launch, affiliate monetization, advertising, remarketing, or rights outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics but not storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, attribution, images, prices, freshness, correction, takedown, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms restrict commercial/public listing use. All four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open with no evidenced closure. Fleet compliance is mixed: 37 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is unavailable fleet-wide, not zero. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy, and any affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: preserve containment and permit only existing reversible work that adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, public sharing, or monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed. Do not close tasks based on partial repository or public-page evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated evidence bundle containing the field-level Woot rights matrix, alert-data retention/deletion/access table, deployed consent and GA4 configuration capture, and log/vendor/incident/request inventory. Keep rights outreach unsent until human counsel review and owner authorization.

Private and gated sites require concrete launch decisions: keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only; keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net unlaunched and preview-only until each has a dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and owner-decision packet. Analytics incompleteness alone does not block ordinary reversible growth, but it does not satisfy a launch gate or support financial, traffic, ROI, or causal claims.
